name: app.htmldrop/mcp
description: Publish HTML or Markdown from any MCP client to a live, shareable URL on htmldrop.app.

environmentVariables.name: HTMLDROP_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: htmldrop API token (hsk_live_…). Create one at https://htmldrop.app/dashboard/settings → API tokens.

environmentVariables.name: HTMLDROP_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Leave unset to use htmldrop.app's hosted API; set only for self-hosted or staging deployments.
